headline: Dark Hole
title: Dark Hole Explained | What It Does and How to Use It | Yu-Gi-Oh
video_script: This is Dark Hole. What is it? It is a Normal Spell Card. What does it do? Destroy all monsters on the field, yours too. How do you use it? Use it when your opponent has more or stronger monsters than you, then rebuild faster. Which card should I explain next? Comment below!
